title: System Software Engineering Intern
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented undergraduate student to join our Linux Core OS Validation team as a system software engineering intern. In this hands-on role, you will contribute to the design, testing, and optimization of Linux Kernel testing, gaining invaluable exposure to real-world engineering challenges. Your work will directly impact product quality and innovation, helping build and validate solutions that support Intel's technologies and platforms.
Business Group
The Linux Core OS Validation team is part of Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), a business unit focused on delivering innovative technologies that power data centers and cloud computing solutions globally. This team ensures the reliability and performance of Intel's platforms by validating system software, optimizing cross-stack solutions, and driving advancements in Linux-based environments. Join a collaborative and forward-thinking group dedicated to supporting the broader Intel mission of delivering world-class solutions for enterprise and cloud customers.
Key Responsibilities
- Analyze and interpret test results from validation runs, identifying meaningful patterns, issues, and regressions.
- Collaborate with team members to debug software failures and validate solutions across various testing environments.
- Contribute to the development and optimization of automation tools using C/Bash/Python to improve test result analysis and reporting efficiency.
- Work with open-source frameworks and tools for system software validation and metrics reporting.
- Support the enhancement of CI/CD pipelines, particularly in areas related to system software validation across diverse hardware configurations.
- Participate in code reviews and team discussions to drive improvements in validation tools and processes.
- Engage with Linux-based environments, gaining familiarity with command-line operations and scripting.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Enrollment in a Bachelor's program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field with 0-1 years of hands-on experience in system software engineering gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.
- Proficiency in C/Bash/Python programming and basic Linux command-line operations.
- Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail in interpreting test results.
- Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical findings clearly.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with version control systems, such as Git, and familiarity with pull request-based workflows.
- Knowledge of test automation frameworks and tools for software validation.
- Familiarity with kernel drivers, hardware validation, or low-level software testing methodologies.
- Enthusiasm for contributing to open-source projects and collaborative development.
If you're ready to dive into system software validation, automation, and hands-on engineering in a dynamic and collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply today to join Intel's Linux Core OS Validation team.
